name: Candy Cane Visualization
definition: A two-field visualization technique where enstrophy defines the opacity and the Seed LIC texture of the vorticity field defines the color, creating vortex tube structures resembling 'candy canes'.
summary: Candy Cane Visualization is a multi-field technique that uses enstrophy for opacity and vorticity LIC for color to reveal vortex tube structures resembling candy canes.
